name: Lamorinda Jewish Preschool
summary: A warm, play-based Jewish preschool in Lafayette, inspired by Reggio Emilia, where every child feels at home.
schedule: Monday to Thursday 8:30 AM – 5:00 PM; Friday 8:00 AM – 3:00 PM
details:
Two classes: **12 to 24 months** and **2 to 4 years**. Children learn through hands-on exploration, guided by Jewish values: kindness, respect, compassion, confidence and responsibility. We follow the principle *Chanoch L'naar Al Pi Darko*: teach each child in their own way.

## Tuition
- $17,000 for the school year, or 10 monthly payments of $1,700
- Includes daily lunch, books, supplies and enrichment
- Drop-in care: $22 per hour, when space allows
- Need-based scholarships are available

## Our team
- **Tzipora Labkowski**, Director: Master's in Education, more than 10 years in education
- **Rivka Burnstein**, 12–24 months class
- **Rivka Yegorova**, 2–4 years class

Enrollment for 2026–2027 is open. Schedule a tour: call 925-384-7242.

name: Lamorinda Hebrew School
summary: Hands-on, fun Jewish learning once a week, Sundays for two hours. Open to all, no membership required.
details:
## Three tracks
- **Early Childhood (ages 3–5):** stories, songs, crafts and holiday celebrations
- **Hebrew School (ages 5–12):** Hebrew reading with Aleph Champ, holidays, traditions and Jewish pride
- **Bar/Bat Mitzvah (ages 12–13):** personal preparation for the big day

## Tuition
$600 per child, including books and supplies. A payment plan is available. No child will be turned away for lack of funds.

## Teachers
Rabbi Yisroel Labkowski, Rebbetzin Tzipora Labkowski, Morah Shira Gold and Morah Rachel Schwartz.

name: CKids Lamorinda Afterschool
summary: Afterschool with homework help, sports, STEAM, Hebrew and Jewish heritage activities, plus a hot meal.
details: Homework help, daily sports and STEAM, modern Hebrew, weekly specials (drama, dance, karate, Shabbat sing), holiday cooking, storytelling, field trips, snacks and lunch or dinner.

name: Lamorinda Jewish Summer Camp
summary: Seven weeks of Jewish songs, Shabbat parties, water play, art and friendship.
details:
Jewish songs and movement, Shabbat celebrations, water play, arts and crafts, sensory play, Hebrew and traditions, mitzvahs and kindness.

$3,200 for the full summer or $500 per week. Spaces are limited; early registration is recommended.

name: Torah Classes for Adults
summary: Weekly Torah, Tanya and Hebrew classes, one-on-one study and lively discussion. Questions welcome.
schedule: Sunday 9 PM (English Torah), Tuesday 8:30 PM (Hebrew, with a meal), Wednesday 1 PM (Tanya)
details: Learn at your own pace, from your very first class to deep Talmud and Kabbalah. Classes include the weekly Torah portion, Tanya (Chassidic philosophy), Explore the Talmud and practical Jewish living. Prefer to learn one-on-one? Ask the Rabbi to set up a study partner.

name: Jewish Women's Circle
summary: Creative evenings, challah bakes, workshops and inspiration with friends.
details: Past evenings include the Mega Challah Bake, Sip & Paint, Latkes & Latte, a ceramic Seder plate workshop and a pre-Shavuot cheese board workshop. Join the list to hear about the next one.

name: Men's Club
summary: Bagels, Lox & Tefillin, Scotch & Steaks in the Sukkah, and good company.
details: Fellowship, learning and a l'chaim. Ask about putting on tefillin or getting your own pair.

name: Kids & Teen Events
summary: Challah and matzah bakes, Havdalah glow parties, Krav Maga for teens, the Rabbi's Kitchen and more.
details: Favorites include the Model Matzah Bakery, Kids Hamantashen Bake, Havdalah Glow Party, Make Your Own Menorah, Sushi in the Sukkah, Mezuzah 4 U, Krav Maga for Teens and the Rabbi's Kitchen for teens.

name: Bar & Bat Mitzvah
summary: Personal, meaningful preparation, with hands-on learning and a Bat Mitzvah Club.
details: Every child learns at their own pace with the Rabbi and Rebbetzin. Boys learn to read from the Torah and put on tefillin; girls join the Bat Mitzvah Club. Find the date with our [Bar/Bat Mitzvah calculator](/tools/bar-bat-mitzvah).

name: Bay Kosher
summary: Kosher meat, groceries and Judaica, ordered online and delivered.
details: Bay Kosher, a project of Chabad of Lamorinda, makes keeping kosher in the East Bay easy: kosher meat and poultry, groceries, holiday foods and Judaica, delivered.

name: Chai Club
summary: No dues, no building fund: our community is carried by monthly partners giving in multiples of 18.
details: Chabad of Lamorinda has no membership dues. The Chai Club partners make it all possible with a monthly gift in multiples of 18 ($18, $36, $72, $180, $360 and up). Give Chai, get Chai! See the [Chai Club honor board](/board/).
